controls.name: Daikin Applied MicroTech chiller controller - Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller alarms
controls.description: MicroTech 4 unit controller on Pathfinder AWV-B/C air-cooled screw chillers (IOM 1242-11, Aug 2025). Three alarm types: Warning, Problem, Fault. The HMI shows the 'displayed text' (code field); circuit alarms print as 'Cn ...' and are listed here as 'C1 ... / C2 ...'. Meaning = alarm name, trigger and action taken as printed; checks = the reset condition. Severity is derived from the action taken (lock out = lockout, shutdown = shutdown, function ignored / backup pump = warning, none = info). The manual table was extracted by column crop; rows garbled in extraction (Bad Demand Limit / Bad LWT Reset, Economizer EXV comm / motor / temperature / pressure sensor, DC fan motor, Compressor VFD fault, Evaporator pressure sensor) were rebuilt from the IOM 1242-11 text. BACnet numeric codes for these alarms are in the 'microtech-chiller-bacnet-alarm-codes' platform. Events (Unit Power Restore, Low Evap Pressure Hold/Unload etc.) are not listed.
appliesTo: Daikin Applied Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller (MicroTech 4)

faultCodes.meaning: Unit GFP Fault - Trigger: All of the following are true: Ground Fault Protection Option set point = Single Point GFP Relay 1 input is off for 1 second. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Auto reset when GFP Relay 1 input is on for 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Circuit 1 GFP Fault - Trigger: All of the following are true: Ground Fault Protection Option set point = Multi Point; GFP Relay 1 input is off for 1 sec. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lockout unit from running.
checks: Reset: Auto reset when GFP Relay 1 input is on for 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Circuit 2 GFP Fault - Trigger: All of the following are true: Ground Fault Protection Option set point = Multi Point; GFP Relay 2 input is off for 1 sec. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lockout unit from running.
checks: Reset: Auto reset when GFP Relay 2 input is on for 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Flow Loss - Trigger: 1: Evap Pump State = Run AND Evap Flow Digital Input = No Flow for time > Flow Proof set point AND at least one circuit is not in the Off state 2: Evap Pump State = Start for time greater than Recirculate Timeout set point and all pumps have been tried and Evap Flow Digital Input = No Flow. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and: • if an auto reset occurrence has triggered, keep unit enabled and allow the evaporator recirculation sequence to proceed • if a manual reset occurrence has been triggered, lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared at any time manually via the keypad or via the BAS clear alarm command. If active via trigger condition 1: When the alarm occurs due to this trigger, it can auto reset the first two times each day, with the third occurrence being manual reset. When the auto reset occurrences are triggered, the unit will remain enabled to run (rather than going to an off state). For the auto reset occurrences, the alarm will reset automatically when the evaporator state is Run again. This means the alarm stays active while the unit waits for flow, then it goes through the recirculation process after flow is detected. Once the recirculation is complete, the evaporator goes to the Run state which will clear the alarm. After three occurrences, the count of occurrences is reset and the cycle starts over if the manual reset flow loss alarm is cleared. If active via trigger condition 2: If the flow loss alarm has occurred due to this trigger, it is always a manual reset alarm.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Water Freeze Protect - Trigger: Evaporator LWT or EWT equal to or less than Evaporator Freeze Protect set point for a time at least as long as the evaporator recirculation time. If the sensor fault is active for either LWT or EWT, then that sensor value cannot trigger the alarm. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad, but only if evaporator LWT and EWT are both above the Evaporator Freeze Protect set point or have a sensor fault (meaning the temperature reading is not valid).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Water Temperatures Inverted - Trigger: All of the following are true for at least 60 seconds: Evap EWT < Evap LWT – 1°C; at least one circuit is in Start or Run state; EWT sensor fault not active; LWT sensor fault not active. Action taken: Normal shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or via BAS command.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator LWT Sensor Fault - Trigger: If any of the following occur for more than one second: Resistance value is < 340 Ω; Resistance value is > 300 kΩ; Reliability value reported for input is anything other than ‘NoFault’. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if the following are true for at least 5 seconds: • Resistance value is from 340 Ω to 300 kΩ • Reliability value reported for input is ‘NoFault’
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator EWT Sensor Fault - Trigger: If any of the following occur for more than one second: Resistance value is < 340 Ω; Resistance value is > 300 kΩ; Reliability value reported for input is anything other than ‘NoFault’. Action taken: Normal shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if the following are true for at least 5 seconds: • Resistance value is from 340 Ω to 300 kΩ • Reliability value reported for input is ‘NoFault’
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: OAT Sensor Fault - Trigger: If any of the following occur for more than one second: Resistance value is < 340 Ω; Resistance value is > 300 kΩ; Reliability value reported for input is anything other than ‘NoFault’. Action taken: Normal shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if the following are true for at least five seconds: • Resistance value is from 340 Ω to 300 kΩ • Reliability value reported for input is ‘NoFault’
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: External Alarm - Trigger: External alarm input is open for at least 1 second. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Auto clear when external alarm input is closed for 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Emergency Stop - Trigger: Emergency Stop input off for 1 second. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or via BAS command after the emergency switch input is on for 5 sec.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: AC Module Comm Failure - Trigger: Communication with the module has failed. Specifically, this means the reliability value reported for the module is anything other than 0 for at least 3 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command after reliability value reported for the module is 0 for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: ESC Module Comm Failure - Trigger: Economizer Check Valves set point = Yes and communication with the module has failed. Specifically, this means the reliability value reported for the module is anything other than 0 for at least 3 seconds. Action taken: Normal shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running.
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command after reliability value reported for the module is 0 for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator EXV Module Comm Failure - Trigger: When evaporator Expansion Valve Type is set as E6V model number (see Table 39), communication with the EVD module called EEXV1 has failed. Specifically, this means that 10 consecutive failures of read/write command blocks for this modbus address have occurred. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command after communication is restored for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: DC Fan Controller Comm Failure - Trigger: Condenser Fan VFD Configuration set point is set to All Fan VFD and heartbeat from DC fan controller is not received for 30 seconds. Action taken: Normal shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if heartbeat from DC fan controller has been received in the last 30 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Pump #1 Failure - Trigger: Unit is configured with primary and backup pumps, pump #1 is running, and the pump control logic switches to pump #2. Action taken: Backup pump is used
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Pump #2 Failure - Trigger: Unit is configured with primary and backup pumps, pump #2 is running, and the pump control logic switches to pump #1. Action taken: Backup pump is used
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Bad Demand Limit Input - Trigger: Demand limit input out of range and Demand Limit set point is set to On. For this alarm, out of range is considered to be a signal less than 3 mA or more than 21 mA. Action taken: Demand limit function and signal are ignored
checks: Reset: Auto clear when Demand Limit set point is set to Off or demand limit input back in range for 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Bad LWT Reset Input - Trigger: LWT Reset Type set point is 4-20 mA and LWT reset input out of range. For this alarm out of range is considered to be a signal less than 3 mA or more than 21 mA. Action taken: LWT reset signal and 4-20 mA function are ignored
checks: Reset: Auto clear when LWT Reset Type set point is not 4-20 mA or LWT reset input back in range for five seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Economizer EXV Module Comm Failure - Trigger: Econ Refrig = Twin, Economizers set point = Yes, and communication with the economizer EXV module has failed. This means that either a modbus configuration error has occurred, or at least 10 consecutive modbus commands failed to receive a valid response. Action taken: Warning: Economizer is moved to closed state and valve command is set to 0% in control logic, though without communication the module is left to operate per logic embedded in it. It should be set up to automatically close the valves when communication is lost. Fault: Normal shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running.
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command after communication is restored for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Treat as Warning category if Econ Check Valves set point = No; treat as Fault category if Econ Check Valves set point = Yes. Unit-level alarm (Econ Refrig = Twin).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: RapidRestore Module Comm Failure - Trigger: RapidRestore set point is set to ‘Yes’ and communication with the RapidRestore module has failed. This means the reliability value reported for the module is anything other than 0 for at least 3 seconds. Action taken: RapidRestore functionality will be disabled while the module is not communicating since an input on the module is required in order to enable the functionality.
checks: Reset: This alarm will automatically clear after communication is restored for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Waterside Economizer EWT Sensor Fault - Trigger: If any of the following occur for more than one second: Resistance value is < 340 Ω; Resistance value is > 300 kΩ; Reliability value reported for input is anything other than ‘NoFault’. Action taken: Cannot use Waterside economizer
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if the following are true for at least 5 seconds: • Resistance value is from 340 Ω to 300 kΩ • Reliability value reported for input is ‘NoFault’
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Waterside Economizer Valve Fault - Trigger: If the following conditions are true for 90 seconds the alarm should be triggered: WSE water valve 1 command = 100%; WSE water valve 1 position < 90% Or, if the following conditions are true for 90 seconds the alarm should be triggered: WSE water valve 2 command = 0%; WSE water valve 2 position > 10% In addition, if the valve position signals are out of range as follows the alarm should be triggered: valve 1 signal is out of range on high side for one second; valve 2 signal is out of range on low side for one second. Action taken: Disable and lock out chiller from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Waterside Economizer Valve Problem - Trigger: If the following conditions are true for 90 seconds the alarm should be triggered: WSE water valve 2 command = 100%; WSE water valve 2 position < 90% Or if the following conditions are true for 90 seconds the alarm should be triggered: WSE water valve 1 command = 0; WSE water valve 1 position > 10% In addition, if the valve position signals are out of range as follows the alarm should be triggered: valve 1 signal is out of range on low side for 1 second; valve 2 signal is out of range on high side for 1 second. Action taken: Waterside Economizer disabled
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Low Evaporator Pressure - Trigger: When circuit state = Start and OAT ≥ -8°C, any of the following can trigger: Evap Pressure < 0 kPa for 5 seconds; Evap Pressure < -50 kPa for 2 seconds When circuit state = Start and OAT < -8°C, any of the following can trigger: Evap Pressure < 0 kPa for 20 seconds; Evap Pressure < -50 kPa for 5 seconds Note: for this condition where OAT is lower than -8°C, the first two times any of the trigger conditions are met in a day the circuit will only shut down and the alarm will not trigger. On the third occurrence in a day, the circuit will shut down and the alarm will be triggered. For first 5 minutes circuit state = Run, any of the following can trigger: Evap Pressure < 0 kPa for 5 seconds; Evap Pressure < -50 kPa for 2 seconds; Evap Pressure < Low Pressure Unload set point for 100 seconds After circuit state = Run for 5 minutes, any of the following can trigger: Evap Pressure < 30 kPa for 5 seconds; Evap Pressure < -30 kPa for 2 seconds; Evap Pressure < Low Pressure Unload set point for time > Freeze Time Where: Freeze Time = 70 – 0.906 x Freeze Error, limited to range of 20-70 seconds; Freeze Error = Low Evap Pressure Unload – Evap Pressure For any trigger condition, the alarm cannot trigger if the evaporator pressure sensor fault is active. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn EvapPressLow" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: High Condenser Pressure - Trigger: Saturated Condenser Temp > Max Saturated Condenser Value for time longer than High Condenser Pressure Delay set point. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad if Saturated Condenser Temp < Max Saturated Condenser Value.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CondPressHigh" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Low Pressure Difference Or Ratio - Trigger: This alarm is triggered on the third occurrence of the below conditions within two hours. Prior occurrences are events. Trigger 1: Pressure ratio is < 1.6 for longer than the Low Pressure Diff/Ratio Delay set point after circuit state transition to Run. Pressure ratio is calculated as shown with pressures in kPa: Ratio = (Cond Press + 101.325)/(Evap Press + 101.325) Trigger 2: Pressure difference is less than 180 kPa for longer than the Low Press Diff/Ratio Delay set point after circuit state transition to Run. Press difference is calculated as shown in kPa: Difference = (Cond Pressure) - (Evap Pressure) Alarm/event cannot trigger for 5 minutes after circuit state transitions to Preopen if OAT < 7°C, however the trigger logic will still run during this window. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm should auto reset every time until it has triggered 3 times within 2 hours and be cleared manually via Unit Controller keypad or BAS.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn LowPrDiffOrRatio" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 MLP Switch / C2 MLP Switch
faultCodes.meaning: Mechanical Low Pressure Switch - Trigger: The alarm is triggered if all of the following are true for at least 40 seconds: Circuit State is Run; MLP Switch input is off The alarm also requires Evaporator Configuration = Remote to trigger. This means if the Evaporator Configuration is set to Packaged then the MLP Switch inputs are ignored and the alarm is disabled. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running.
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI if the MLP Switch input is on.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn MLP Switch" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 MHP Switch / C2 MHP Switch
faultCodes.meaning: Mechanical High Pressure Switch - Trigger: With F3 and F4 compressor types: Compressor VFD reports Safe Disable Input alarm. This is the case when the alarm code reported by the VFD is either 003B or 003C (hex). With 3120 and 3122 compressor types: This alarm will trigger if the compressor VFD reports the Safe Torque Off alarm. This is detected when register 8196 (Active Alarm Group word) bit 13 is set and register 532 (Alarm Code 13) = 1, both for two seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running. Note that VFD will shut down compressor directly in response to this alarm in the VFD. Controller then needs to move circuit to the off state, but compressor should already be turned off by the VFD.
checks: Reset: With F3 and F4 compressor types: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI if the VFD is no longer reporting the Safe Disable Input alarm for at least a minute. With 3120 and 3122 compressor types: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI. When the alarms are cleared in the controller, the command to clear alarms in the VFDs should be sent to them.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn MHP Switch" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: High Discharge Temperature - Trigger: The following are true for 5 seconds: Discharge Temp > High Discharge Temp set point; Discharge temp sensor fault is not active. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command when Discharge Temp is below the High Discharge Temp set point.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn DiscTempHigh" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 Oil PD High / C2 Oil PD High
faultCodes.meaning: High Oil Pressure Drop - Trigger: Circuit is in the Start or Run state and Oil Pressure Drop > High Oil Pressure Drop value for a time longer than High Oil Pressure Drop Delay set point. High Oil Pressure Drop value is calculated as shown below. Operating PD = Condenser Pressure – Evaporator Pressure Minimum for High Oil Pressure Difference = High Oil Pressure Difference Minimum set point Maximum for High Oil Pressure Difference = High Oil Pressure Difference Minimum set point + 500 kPa Note that the set point exists individually for each circuit. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn Oil PD High" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 Oil Feed Loss / C2 Oil Feed Loss
faultCodes.meaning: Oil Feed Loss - Trigger: The following are true for 20 second: Oil Presence Sensor setting is ‘Yes’; Compressor is running; Oil Presence Sensor input is off. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn Oil Feed Loss" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 Motor Temp High / C2 Motor Temp High
faultCodes.meaning: High Motor Temperature - Trigger: Compressor VFD reports motor overheat fault. The fault code for this is 0020H. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad when compressor has been off for at least 5 minutes. When the alarm is cleared in the unit controller, the command to clear the fault in the VFD will be sent.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn Motor Temp High" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor Multiple Start Failure - Trigger: This alarm is triggered on the third occurrence of the below conditions within 2 hours. Prior occurrences are events. All of the following must be true to trigger: Compressor Run command is on; Compressor VFD Communication Failure is not active; Either VFD Actual Speed = 0 for more than 15 seconds or VFD Actual Speed < 13 Hz for more than 30 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CompMultiStartFail" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 No Press At Start / C2 No Press At Start
faultCodes.meaning: No Pressure At Start - Trigger: All of the following must be true to trigger: Circuit start requested; Condenser Fan VFD Configuration set point = None; Either Evaporator Pressure or Condenser Pressure are less than 35 kPa (5.1 psi). Action taken: Abort start of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or BAS command if Evap Pressure and Cond Pressure are at least 35 kPa (5.1 psi).
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn No Press At Start" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 Disc SH Low / C2 Disc SH Low
faultCodes.meaning: Low Discharge Superheat - Trigger: If all of the following are true for at least 30 minutes, the alarm is triggered: Circuit state is Start or Run; Liquid injection is off; DSH < Low DSH Limit set point. Action taken: Normal shutdown of circuit
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn Disc SH Low" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 CmpVFD Curr Out Hi / C2 CmpVFD Curr Out Hi
faultCodes.meaning: High Compressor VFD Output Current - Trigger: VFD Output Current > Max Motor Current x 1.05 for at least 30 seconds Trigger 2: [VFD Output Current > Max Motor Current x 0.99 AND Compressor Speed < 20 Hz] for at least 180 seconds . See the section covering circuit level calculations for the details on the Max Motor Current value. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running.
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CmpVFD Curr Out Hi" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 CmpVFD Curr In Hi / C2 CmpVFD Curr In Hi
faultCodes.meaning: High Compressor VFD Input Current - Trigger: Alarm will trigger when all of the following are true for at least 5 seconds: Unit mode is Ice; Compressor is running; VFD Input Current > Compressor RLA set point x 105% Compressor RLA set point for each circuit is part of the unit configuration. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CmpVFD Curr In Hi" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Temperature High - Trigger: VFD Heatsink temperature > Max VFD Temperature for 5 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command if temperature ≤ Max VFD Temperature.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CompVfdTempHigh" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Temperature Low - Trigger: This alarm is triggered if the Compressor Type is set as 3120 or 3122 and Compressor VFD Temp ≤ -10°C for at least 5 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command if Compressor VFD temperature > -5°C.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CompVfdTempLow" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Comm Failure - Trigger: Unit has compressor VFD’s and there is either a modbus configuration error or there are 10 consecutive modbus commands that failed to receive a valid response. Action taken: Normal shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or via BAS command if communication has been restored.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CompVfdCommFail" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: CC1 Module Comm Fail / CC2 Module Comm Fail
faultCodes.meaning: CC Module Comm Failure - Trigger: Communication with the module has failed. Specifically, this means the reliability value reported for the module is anything other than 0 for at least 3 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command after reliability value reported for the module is 0 for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "CCn Module Comm Fail" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: EEXV1 Mod Comm Fail / EEXV2 Mod Comm Fail
faultCodes.meaning: EEXV Module Comm Failure - Trigger: Evaporator Expansion Valve Type is set as an ETS model number (see Table 39) and communication with the module has failed. Specifically, this means the reliability value reported for the module is anything other than 0 for at least 3 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command after reliability value reported for the module is 0 for at least 5 seconds. Compressor VFD Fault
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "EEXVn Mod Comm Fail" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 Comp Vfd Fault / C2 Comp Vfd Fault
faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Fault - Trigger: F3/F4 compressor types: Fault flag from VFD is set and fault code is not 0020H. Other alarms trigger in response to specific fault codes so if the fault is due to those codes, this alarm should not trigger. With 3120 and 3122 compressor types: There will be a 10 second delay after the controller boots before allowing this alarm to trigger. The alarm will trigger when register 8196 (Active Alarm Group word) ≠ 0 for two seconds and neither of the following alarm trigger conditions are met: Register 8196 (Active Alarm Group word) bit 5 is set and register 524 (Alarm Code 5) = 0; Register 8196 (Active Alarm Group word) bit 13 is set and register 532 (Alarm Code 13) = 1 The above trigger conditions are for the High Motor Temperature alarm and the Safe Torque Off alarm in the VFD, both are handled as discreet alarms in the controller. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller keypad or BAS command. When alarm is cleared, command to reset fault should be sent to VFD.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn Comp Vfd Fault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Pressure Sensor Fault - Trigger: Trigger any time sensor input voltage is less than 400mv and UC communication with CC module is OK, for at least 1 second. Trigger when sensor input voltage is more than 4600mv and UC communication with CC module is OK, for at least 1 second. However, this trigger should only occur after circuit state is start or run for at least 90 seconds. Trigger if the evaporator approach is less than 1.11°C for more than 100 seconds during the first 5 minutes the compressor is running, and more than 30 seconds thereafter. This trigger should only be enabled after the circuit state is start or run for 30 seconds. The purpose of this trigger condition is to prevent operation if the sensor is reading high but not out of range. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if sensor input voltage is 400 mv to 4600 mv for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn EvapPressSenFault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Condenser Pressure Sensor Fault - Trigger: Trigger any time sensor input voltage is less than 400 mv or more than 4600 mv and UC communication with CC module is OK for at least 1 second. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if sensor input voltage is 400 mv to 4600 mv for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CondPressSenFault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Oil Pressure Sensor Fault - Trigger: Trigger any time sensor input voltage is less than 400 mv or more than 4600 mv and UC communication with CC module is OK for at least 1 second. Action taken: Normal shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if sensor input voltage is 400 mv to 4600 mv for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn OilPressSenFault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Suction Temperature Sensor Fault - Trigger: Trigger if any of the following are true for at least 1 second: Sensor input value < 340 Ω; Sensor input value > 300 kΩ; Sensor reliability reported by control system ≠ ‘No Fault’. Action taken: Normal shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if sensor input value is 340 Ω to 300 kΩ and sensor reliability = ‘No Fault’ for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn SuctTempSenFault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Discharge Temperature Sensor Fault - Trigger: Trigger if any of the following are true for at least 1 second: Sensor input value < 340 Ω; Sensor input value > 300 kΩ; Sensor reliability reported by control system ≠ ‘No Fault’. Action taken: Normal shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if sensor input value is 340 Ω to 300 kΩ and sensor reliability = ‘No Fault’ for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn DiscTempSenFault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator EXV Motor Error - Trigger: If EEXV Type is set to E6V and driver in Evaporator EXV module reports EXV motor error. Driver A is for circuit #1 and Driver B is for circuit #2. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if EXV motor error is no longer being reported.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn EvapExvMotorErr" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Power Loss While Running - Trigger: Circuit running when controller loses power. Action taken: None
checks: Reset: N/A
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn PwrLossWhileRun" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.code: C1 Pumpdown Fail / C2 Pumpdown Fail
faultCodes.meaning: Failed Pumpdown - Trigger: Circuit state = pumpdown for time > Pumpdown Time set point. Action taken: Shut down circuit
checks: Reset: N/A
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn Pumpdown Fail" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Economizer Pressure Sensor Fault - Trigger: The following conditions must be true to trigger: Economizer Configuration set point = Yes; 8 seconds have passed since UC booted up; Communication with EVD module is OK Value reported is more than 3083 kPa or less than 3.85 kPa for at least 1 second. Action taken: Warning: Economizer forced to closed state and will remain in closed state. Fault: Normal shutdown of circuit and lock out from running.
checks: Reset: Warning: This alarm will automatically clear if value reported is from 3.85 to 3083 kPa for five seconds. Fault: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command if value reported is from 3.85 to 3083 kPa for five seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Treat as Warning category if Econ Check Valves set point = No; treat as Fault category if Econ Check Valves set point = Yes. Printed as "Cn EconPressSenFault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Economizer Temperature Sensor Fault - Trigger: The following conditions must be true to trigger: Economizer Configuration set point = Yes; Communication with EVD module is OK; Value reported is more than 150°C or less than -40°C for at least 1 second. Action taken: Economizer forced to closed state and will remain closed.
checks: Reset: This alarm will automatically clear if value reported is from -40°C to 150°C for 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn EconTempSenFault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Economizer EXV Motor Error - Trigger: The following conditions must be true to trigger: Economizers set point = Yes; Economizer Check Valves set point; [a] driver in Economizer EXV module reports EXV motor error (printed as 'No driver in Economizer EXV module reports EXV motor error'). Driver A is for circuit 1 and Driver B is for circuit 2. Action taken: Warning: Economizer forced to closed state and will remain in closed state. Fault: Normal shutdown of circuit and lock out from running.
checks: Reset: Warning: Automatically clear when EXV motor error is not being reported for five seconds. Fault: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command when EXV motor error is not being reported for five seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Treat as Warning category if Econ Check Valves set point = No; treat as Fault category if Econ Check Valves set point = Yes. Printed as "Cn EconExvMotorErr" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: DC Fan Motor Fault (ECM/DC Fan Motor Fault) - Trigger: Any ECM/DC fan motor on the circuit has a fault as indicated by a flag sent from the DC controller. Action taken: None
checks: Reset: Fault flag is not set for at least one second. This alarm can be cleared manually via the keypad or BAS command if trigger condition is not true. When the alarm clear command is set via keypad or BAS, a request to clear alarms is sent to the DC controller.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn DcFanMotorFault" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

faultCodes.meaning: Economizer EXV Module Comm Failure (circuit) - Trigger: Econ Refrig = 2 Single, Economizers set point = Yes, and communication with one economizer EXV module has failed. This means that either a modbus configuration error has occurred, or at least 10 consecutive modbus commands failed to receive a valid response. Action taken: Warning: Economizer is moved to closed state and valve command is set to 0% in control logic, though without communication the module is left to operate per logic embedded in it. It should be set up to automatically close the valve when communication is lost. Fault: Normal shutdown of the and lock out circuit from running.
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command after communication is restored for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.notes: Treat as Warning category if Econ Check Valves set point = No; treat as Fault category if Econ Check Valves set point = Yes. Circuit-level alarm (Econ Refrig = 2 Single). Printed as "Cn EconExvModCommFail" (n = circuit number).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1242-11 (Aug 2025) Pathfinder AWV air-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Alarms and Events, pp.79-90

diagnosticTips: Alarm digital output: Off = no alarms; blinking (5 s on / 5 s off) = one circuit has an alarm preventing it from running; On = unit alarm or both circuits locked out (IOM 1242-11 p.79).
Active alarm list is newest first; the alarm log marks '+' when triggered and '-' when cleared and keeps 25 previous alarms; export with 'Log Export to SD' (IOM 1242-11).

Clear from the keypad (Alarms > Active Alarms, set clear to On; no password) or BAS (BACnet ClearAlarms BV:8, LON nviClearAlarms). Alarms clear only if the trigger condition no longer exists; cycling controller power also clears alarms (IOM 1242-11; ED 15120-12).

Flow loss while running auto-resets the first two times each day; the third occurrence needs a manual reset. If flow is never proven at start after every pump has been tried, it is always a manual reset (IOM 1242-11).
Low evaporator pressure freezestat: freeze time = 70 - 0.906 x freeze error, limited to 20-70 s, where freeze error = Low Evap Pressure Unload - evaporator pressure (kPa) (IOM 1242-11).
Low ambient lockout is not an alarm but is annunciated over BACnet as Problem code 16642 'START INHIBITED - Ambient Temperature Low' (ED 15120-12).

sourceDocs.title: Daikin Applied Pathfinder AWV IOM - Alarms and Events pp.79-90

controls.name: Daikin Applied MicroTech chiller controller - Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32) alarms
controls.description: MicroTech unit controller on Trailblazer AGZ-F (R-32) air-cooled scroll chillers, IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026). Each alarm has a 10-digit alarm code (unit alarms one code; circuit alarms a Circuit 1 code and a Circuit 2 code = Circuit 1 + 1024). Code field = alarm name plus the printed code number(s), so searching either the name or the number finds it. Meaning gives the type (Fault / Problem / Warning), the message / module type / module ID / payload parts, the trigger and the action taken; checks give the reset condition. Severity derived from the action taken. Also includes the DC Fan Fault problem (code generated per fan and payload) and the three capacity-limiting events. Complete transcription of the IOM 1359-4 alarm tables.
appliesTo: Daikin Applied Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32)

faultCodes.meaning: PVM/GFP Fault - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 228 / 1 / 0 / 1). Trigger: Alarm is trigged if all of the following are true for at least one second:; Power Configuration = Single Point; PVM/GFP Input #1 is off. Action taken: Shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Reset when input is on for at least 5 seconds or if Power Configuration = Multi Point
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Flow Loss - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 150 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: 1: Evaporator Pump State = Run AND Evaporator Flow input is off for time > Flow Proof Set Point AND at least one compressor running 2: Evaporator Pump State = Start for time greater than Recirc Timeout Set Point and all pumps have been tried and Evaporator Flow input is off. Action taken: Shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Alarm trigger no longer exists
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Water Freez Protect - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 151 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: [Evaporator LWT drops below evaporator freeze protect set point and LWT sensor fault is not active] for a time longer than the evaporator recirculation time set point. Action taken: Shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Alarm trigger no longer exists – Cannot be auto cleared
faultCodes.notes: HMI displayed text as printed: "Evaporator Water Freeze Protect". Alarm name spelling 'Freez' is as printed in the manual. Cannot be auto cleared.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator LWT Sensor Fault - Warning alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 162 / 5 / 0 / 0). Trigger: Trigger any time sensor status is other than “10” and UC01 communication with UE01 module is OK, for at least one second. Action taken: Shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Sensor status returns to “10”
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator EWT Sensor Fault - Warning alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 2 / 5 / 0 / 0). Trigger: Trigger any time sensor status is other than “10” and UC01 communication with UE01 module is OK, for at least one second. Action taken: Ignore sensor value in applicable calculations
checks: Reset: Sensor status returns to “10”
faultCodes.notes: HMI displayed text as printed: "Evaporator Water Freeze Protect". The manual prints the Freeze Protect text as this alarm's displayed text - likely a manual typo.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: OAT Sensor Fault - Warning alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 128 / 5 / 0 / 0). Trigger: Trigger any time sensor status is other than “10” and UC01 communication with UE01 module is OK, for at least one second. Action taken: Shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Sensor status returns to “10”
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: External Alarm - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 194 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: External Alarm/Event input is off for at least 5 seconds and external fault input is configured as a fault. Action taken: Shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Alarm trigger no longer exists
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Pump #1 Failure - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 81 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: Unit is configured with primary and backup pumps, pump #1 is running, and the pump control logic switches to pump #2. Action taken: Backup pump is used
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Pump #2 Failure - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 81 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: Unit is configured with primary and backup pumps, pump #2 is running, and the pump control logic switches to pump #1. Action taken: Backup pump is used
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or BAS command
faultCodes.notes: Printed message code 81, but code 1375797248 decodes to message code 82 (printed-table mismatch).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: External Event - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 13 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: External Alarm/Event input is off for at least 5 seconds and external fault input is configured as a warning. Action taken: None
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Bad Demand Limit Input - Warning alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 9 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: Demand limit input out of range and Demand Limit set point is set to On. For this alarm out of range is considered to be a signal less than 3mA or more than 21mA. Action taken: Demand limit function and signal are ignored
checks: Reset: Demand Limit set point is set to Off or demand limit input back in range for 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Bad LWT Reset Input - Warning alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 8 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: LWT Reset is enabled and LWT reset input out of range. For this alarm out of range is considered to be a signal less than 3mA or more than 21mA. Action taken: LWT reset signal and function are ignored
checks: Reset: LWT Reset Type set point is not 4-20mA or LWT reset input back in range for 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Low OAT Lockout - Warning alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 65 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: Low OAT Lockout is active and BAS Alert setpoint is enabled. Action taken: Specified in Low OAT Lockout Section
checks: Reset: Alarm trigger no longer exists
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Transformer Overtemperature Fault - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 247 / 1 / 0 / 0). Trigger: The unit is configured with a transformer and the transformer over-temperature input is off. Action taken: Shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Alarm trigger no longer exists, or the unit is reconfigured to not have a transformer
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Transformer Temperature Sensor Error - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 246 / 5 / 0 / 0). Trigger: The unit is configured with a transformer and the sensor status is other than “10” and UC01 communication with UE01 module is OK, for at least one second. Action taken: Ignore transformer unload logic
checks: Reset: Sensor status returns to “10”, or the unit is reconfigured to not have a transformer
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Peripheral Module Comm Failure - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 188 / 4,6,7 / 0 / 0; codes Expansion Module – Sensor Box: 3154380800 Expansion Module – Main Box: 3154575360 Dual EXV Driver: 3154509824). Trigger: Modbus communication is lost with any of the above modules, only if applicable to current configuration. Action taken: Shutdown all circuits and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: Alarm trigger no longer exists, or the unit is reconfigured to not the affected module
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: PVM/FFP Fault - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 228 / 8 / 1,2 / 1,2; codes Circuit 1 GFM: 3825730561 Circuit 2 GFM: 3825731585 Circuit 1 PVM: 3825730562 Circuit 2 PVM: 3825731586). Trigger: [Power Configuration = Multi Point and PVM/GFP input is off] for longer than one second. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: PVM/GFP input is on for at least 5 seconds or if Power Configuration = Single Point
faultCodes.notes: 'PVM/FFP' as printed (the unit-level alarm is 'PVM/GFP Fault'); codes are printed per circuit for GFM and PVM.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Mechanical High Pressure Switch - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 166 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 2785543168 Circuit 2: 2785544192). Trigger: Mechanical High Pressure switch input is off for longer than one second. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: Alarm trigger no longer exists – Cannot be auto cleared
faultCodes.notes: Cannot be auto cleared.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Mechanical Low Pressure Switch - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 186 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 3121087488 Circuit 2: 3121088512). Trigger: Mechanical Low Pressure switch input is off for longer than 40 seconds and the circuit state is run. This alarm requires Evaporator configuration = Remote Evap to trigger. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: Alarm trigger no longer exists – Cannot be auto cleared
faultCodes.notes: Cannot be auto cleared.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Low Evaporator Pressure - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 153 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 2567439360 Circuit 2: 2567440384). Trigger: This alarm should trigger when Freeze time is exceeded, Low Ambient Start is not active, and Circuit State = Run. It should also trigger if [Evaporator Pressure < Low Evaporator Pressure Fault setpoint and Circuit State = Run] for longer than one second. Freezestat logic allows the circuit to run for varying times at low pressures. The lower the pressure, the shorter the time the compressor can run. This time is calculated as follows: Freeze error = Low Evaporator Pressure Unload – Evaporator Pressure Freeze time = • For units equipped with shell and tube type evaporator: 80 – (freeze error/6.895), limited to a range of 40 to 80 seconds • For units with plate frame type evaporator: 60 – (freeze error/6.895), limited to a range of 20 to 60 seconds When the evaporator pressure goes below the Low Evaporator Pressure Unload set point, a timer starts. If this timer exceeds the freeze time, then a freezestat trip occurs. If the evaporator pressure rises to the unload set point or higher, and the freeze time has not been exceeded, the timer will reset. The alarm cannot trigger if the evaporator pressure sensor fault is active. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: Evaporator Pressure > Low Evaporator Pressure Fault setpoint
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: High Condenser Pressure - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 145 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 2433221632 Circuit 2: 2433222656). Trigger: Condenser Pressure > High Condenser Pressure Fault setpoint for longer than one second. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: If the Condenser Pressure < High Condenser Pressure Fault setpoint
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: High Discharge Temperature - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 148 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 2483553280 Circuit 2: 2483554304). Trigger: Discharge Temperature > High Discharge Temperature Fault setpoint for longer than one second. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: If the Discharge Temperature < High Discharge Temperature Fault setpoint
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Motor Protection Fault - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 133 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 2231895040 Circuit 2: 2231896064). Trigger: Circuit has at least one compressor with a Motor Protection Module and [Motor Protection input is off and power up start delay is not active] for longer than one second. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: Motor Protection input is on
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Low OAT Restart Fault - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 161 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 2701657088 Circuit 2: 2701658112). Trigger: Circuit has failed three low OAT start attempts. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or via BAS command, or auto cleared as outlined in the section below
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: No Pressure Change After Start - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 189 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 3171419136 Circuit 2: 3171420160). Trigger: After start of compressor, at least a 7 KPA (1 PSI) drop in evaporator pressure OR 35 KPA (5.1 PSI) increase in condenser pressure has not occurred after 30 seconds. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or via BAS command, or auto cleared as outlined in the section below
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Low Suction SH Fault - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 219 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 3674735616 Circuit 2: 3674736640). Trigger: SSH < 3F for 5 minutes consecutive. Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running for 30 minutes
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or via BAS command, or auto cleared as outlined in the section below once the 30-minute timer has expired
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89

faultCodes.meaning: Low Condenser Sat. Temperature - Fault alarm (message/module type/ID/payload 155 / 8 / 1,2 / 0; codes Circuit 1: 3691512832 Circuit 2: 3691513856). Trigger: Condenser Sat. Temperature is less than the limit for 5 consecutive minutes, where the limit is defined as: Evaporator Sat. Evaporator Sat. Temperature <= 30°F Temperature > 30°F Limit = 50°F Limit = (1.2 * Evaporator Sat. Temperature) + 11.6 (all in °F). Action taken: Shutdown circuit and lock circuit out from running for 60 minutes.
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the controller HMI or via BAS command, or auto cleared as outlined in the section below once the 60-minute timer has expired

faultCodes.meaning: DC Fan Fault - Problem alarm (message 33 / module type 3 Fans / fan module ID 11-18 = fans 1-8 on circuit 1, 21-26 = fans 1-6 on circuit 2 / payload = fan fault number); code generated case by case. Trigger: a DC fan reports an alarm. Action taken: ignore the affected fan in condenser staging logic.
likelyCauses: DC fan payloads (verbatim): 0 Modbus Communication Error; 1 VDC Overvoltage; 2 VDC Undervoltage; 3 Phase Overcurrent; 4 Out of Step or Blocked; 6 Lack of Phase; 7 Inverter IPM Fault Edge; 8 Inverter IPM Fault Level; 11 VAC Lack of Phase; 13 Motor Power Over Limit; 14 VAC RMS Overvoltage; 15 Abnormal Phase Current at Zero Point; 16 Overpower Limit; 17 Low Voltage Limit; 18 IPM Over Temp Limit; 22 Modbus Comms Timeout; 26 VAC RMS Undervoltage; 28 IPM Abnormal Temperature; 38 Inner Comm Fault; 39 Incorrect Drive Enable Level

faultCodes.code: C1 Low Evap Pr Hold / C2 Low Evap Pr Hold
faultCodes.meaning: Low Evaporator Pressure - Hold (event, no lockout): inhibits capacity increase.
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn Low Evap Pr Hold".
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89 (Events pp.88-89)

faultCodes.code: C1 Low Evap Pr Unld / C2 Low Evap Pr Unld
faultCodes.meaning: Low Evaporator Pressure - Unload (event, no lockout): triggers when the circuit is in Run, more than one compressor is running, and evaporator pressure is at or below the unload set point for more than half the current freezestat time, the circuit is not in a low OAT start, and at least 30 s have passed since a compressor start; stages off one compressor every 10 s except the last; resets when evaporator pressure is above the Hold SP + 90 kPa (13 psi).
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn Low Evap Pr Unld".
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89 (Events pp.88-89)

faultCodes.code: C1 High Cond Pr Unld / C2 High Cond Pr Unld
faultCodes.meaning: High Condenser Pressure - Unload (event, no lockout): stages off one compressor every 10 s except the last and inhibits staging; resets when condenser pressure is at or below the Unload SP - 862 kPa (125 psi).
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn High Cond Pr Unld".
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1359-4 (Aug 2026) Trailblazer AGZ-F air-cooled scroll chiller (R-32), Unit Controller Operation > Alarms, pp.79-89 (Events pp.88-89)

diagnosticTips: Decoding a 10-digit unit alarm code (derived by the researcher from the printed codes - medium confidence): Alarm Code = Message Code x 16,777,216 + Module Type x 65,536 + Payload; e.g. PVM/GFP Fault 228/1/0/1 = 3825270785. Circuit 2 codes are Circuit 1 + 1024. Use the printed codes rather than computing them.

Module types (IOM 1359-4 p.81): 1 Unit (payload 1 Ground Fault Monitor, 2 Phase Voltage Monitor); 3 Fans (IDs 11-18 circuit 1 fans 1-8, 21-26 circuit 2 fans 1-6); 4 cpCOe expansion module, sensor box (UE01); 5 Sensor (0 unit, 1 circuit 1, 2 circuit 2); 6 EXV (0 dual EXV driver, 1/2 circuit EXV); 7 BAS expansion module, main box (UE02); 8 Circuit (1, 2); 100 PC.

Auto clearing (IOM 1359-4 p.88): auto-clear happens only if no alarm that cannot be auto cleared is present; the first successful auto-clear starts a one-hour timer and no more than 3 successful auto-clears can occur while it runs.

Factory alarm set points (IOM 1359-4 pp.48-49): Evaporator Water Freeze 2.2°C (36°F); Flow Loss Delay 5 s (5-15 s); Recirculate Timeout 3 min (1-10 min); Low Ambient Lockout 1.7°C (35.1°F); Low Evap Pressure Hold 696.4 kPa (103 psi) / Unload 689.5 kPa (102 psi) / Fault 151.7 kPa (22 psi, range 20-30 psi); High Condenser Pressure Hold 3550.8 kPa (515 psi) / Unload 4137 kPa (600 psi) / Fault 4206 kPa (610 psi, range 480-620 psi); High Discharge Temperature Fault 121°C (250°F, range 200-300°F).

Freezestat freeze time (Trailblazer AGZ-F): shell-and-tube 80 - (error/6.895) limited to 40-80 s; brazed-plate 60 - (error/6.895) limited to 20-60 s; error = Low Evap Pressure Unload - evaporator pressure (kPa).

controls.name: Daikin Applied Magnitude magnetic-bearing centrifugal chiller alarms (WMC-D/TMC, WMC-E, WME-C, WME-D, WMT)
controls.description: Magnitude chillers have no numeric alarm codes: the HMI shows a text message (code field). Two generations: (1) WMC-D/TMC (IOM 1210-8) and WMC-E (IOM 1389) show 'ACTION - condition' messages (COMPR STOP -, CHILLER STOP -, NO LOAD -, UNLOAD -, NO ACTION -, COND/EVAP PUMP ON -), grouped as Unit/Compressor Fault, Problem, Warning and Event tables with an Alarm Reset column; several underlying alarms share one message, listed in the meaning. Alarms with 'No Alert shown on HMI panel' are listed by description. (2) WME-C (IOM 1266-6), WME-D (IOM 1372) and WMT (IOM 1297-1) use Critical / Warning screen texts with a trigger condition and printed causes; triggers that differ by model are given per model. Severity: Fault/Critical = shutdown (lockout where the reset says locked off), Problem/Warning = warning, events and no-HMI items = info. BACnet numeric codes (WME-B etc.) are in the 'microtech-chiller-bacnet-alarm-codes' platform. Complete transcription of the tables in the five manuals.
appliesTo: Daikin Applied Magnitude WMC-D / TMC, WMC-E, WME-C, WME-D (heat recovery) and WMT (R-1233zd(E)) magnetic-bearing centrifugal chillers

diagnosticTips: Alarm classes (IOM 1389 p.52): Shutdown Alarm / Fault in red text = equipment protection that shuts off a unit or compressor; Warning / Problem in yellow = limits loading and clears automatically when corrected; Event in black = notification only.

WME/WMT: critical alarms that need no outside intervention may auto-clear; an auto-cleared critical alarm shows yellow unless 3 have occurred within the hour, then red (IOM 1297-1 p.41). Repeatedly clearing critical alarms manually without fixing the cause can damage the chiller and void the warranty (IOM 1266-6 p.41).
WMC-D/E bearing and motor faults pause the chiller 20 min after the 3rd alarm in 50 min (IOM 1210-8 Table 25).
For Daikin Applied tech support, export the original, unmodified Trend.csv and Alarm.csv files over USB (IOM 1389 p.53).
Leak detection dyes are not tested or recommended by Daikin Applied for its chillers and void the warranty (IOM 1389 p.58).

Model thresholds: High Motor Winding Temperature >298°F on WME-C/WME-D, >150°F on WMT; High Motor Gap Temperature >130°F; Max RLA Exceeded = VFD output >115% of nameplate RLA set point; High Suction Temperature Fault >125°F; High Discharge Temperature Fault >150°F.

controls.name: Daikin Applied MicroTech chiller controller - Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller alarms
controls.description: MicroTech unit controller on Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chillers (R-134a / R-513A), IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026). An alarm makes the unit or circuit do a rapid or normal shutdown, shows a bell icon and energizes the optional remote alarm output. Code field = HMI text ('C1' = circuit number as printed in the manual's examples); combined evaporator/condenser rows list both texts. Meaning = alarm name, level (unit / circuit), trigger and action taken; checks = reset condition; severity derived from the action taken. Also lists the log-only events (Unit Power Restore, pressure / VFD current / VFD temperature hold and unload, low pressure ratio, compressor start failure) as info. BACnet numeric codes are in 'microtech-chiller-bacnet-alarm-codes'. Complete transcription of the IOM 1264-5 alarm descriptions.
appliesTo: Daikin Applied Navigator WWV / TWV water-cooled screw chiller

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Flow Loss (Unit level) - Trigger: 1: Evap Pump State = Run AND Evap Flow Digital Input = No Flow for time > Flow Loss Delay set point AND at least one circuit is not in the Off state 2: Evap Pump State = Start for time greater than Recirculate Timeout set point and all pumps have been tried and Evap Flow Digital Input = No Flow. Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and: - if an auto reset occurrence has triggered, keep unit enabled and allow the evaporator recirculation sequence to proceed - if a manual reset occurrence has been triggered, lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared at any time manually via the keypad or via the BAS clear alarm command. If active via trigger condition 1: When the alarm occurs due to this trigger, it can auto reset the first two times each day, with the third occurrence being manual reset. When the auto reset occurrences are triggered the unit will remain enabled to run (rather than going to an off state) For the auto reset occurrences, the alarm will reset automatically when the evaporator state is Run again. This means the alarm stays active while the unit waits for flow, then it goes through the recirculation process after flow is detected. Once the recirculation is complete, the evaporator goes to the Run state which will clear the alarm. After three occurrences, the count of occurrences is reset and the cycle starts over if the manual reset flow loss alarm is cleared If active via trigger condition 2: If the flow loss alarm has occurred due to this trigger, it is always a manual reset alarm
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

Action taken: Rapid shutdown all circuits and: -if an auto reset occurrence has triggered, keep unit enabled and allow the evaporator recirculation sequence to proceed -if a manual reset occurrence has been triggered, lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared at any time manually via the keypad or via the BAS clear alarm command. If active via trigger condition 1: When the alarm occurs due to this trigger, it can auto reset the first two times each day, with the third occurrence being manual reset. When the auto reset occurrences are triggered the unit will remain enabled to run (rather than going to an off state) For the auto reset occurrences, the alarm will reset automatically when the evaporator state is Run again. This means the alarm stays active while the unit waits for flow, then it goes through the recirculation process after flow is detected. Once the recirculation is complete, the evaporator goes to the Run state which will clear the alarm. After three occurrences, the count of occurrences is reset and the cycle starts over if the manual reset flow loss alarm is cleared If active via trigger condition 2: If the flow loss alarm has occurred due to this trigger, it is always a manual reset alarm

faultCodes.code: Evap Water Freeze / Cond Water Freeze
faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator/Condenser Water Freeze Protect (Unit level) - Trigger: LWT or EWT equal to or less than Freeze Protect set point for a time at least as long as the evaporator recirculation time. If the sensor fault is active for either LWT or EWT, then that sensor value cannot trigger the alarm. Action taken: Rapid shutdown unit and lock out unit from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the unit controller HMI, but only if specific LWT and EWT are both above the specified Freeze Protect set point or have a sensor fault (meaning the temperature reading is not valid)
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48
