faultCodes.code: Evap Pump1Fault / Evap Pump2Fault / Cond Pump1Fault / Cond Pump2Fault
faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator/Condenser Pump #1 or #2 Failure (Unit level) - Trigger: Unit is configured with primary and backup pumps, pump #1 (or #2) is running, and the pump control logic switches to pump #2 and vice versa. Action taken: Backup pump is used
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the unit controller HMI or BAS command
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Evap Pump1(or 2)Fault/Cond Pump1(or 2)Fault".
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Bad Demand Limit Input (Unit level) - Trigger: Demand limit input out of range and Demand Limit set point is set to Enable. For this alarm out of range is considered to be a signal less than 3mA or more than 21mA. Action taken: Demand limit function and signal ignored
checks: Reset: Auto clear when Demand Limit set point is set to Disable or demand limit input back in range for 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Bad LWT Reset Input (Unit level) - Trigger: LWT Reset set point is Enable and LWT reset input is out of range. For this alarm out of range is considered to be a signal less than 3mA or more than 21mA. Action taken: LWT reset signal and reset function ignored
checks: Reset: Auto clear when LWT Reset set point is Disable or LWT Reset input back in range for 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: RapidRestore Module Comm Failure (Unit level) - Trigger: RapidRestore set point is set to ‘Yes’ and communication with the RapidRestore module has failed. This means the reliability value reported for the module is anything other than 0 for at least 3 seconds. Action taken: RapidRestore functionality will be disabled while the module is not communicating since an input on the module is required in order to enable the functionality
checks: Reset: This alarm will automatically clear after communication is restored for at least 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Low Evaporator Pressure (Circuit level) - Trigger: Trigger 1 - This alarm will trigger when Freeze time is exceeded and Circuit State = Start or Run. Freezestat logic allows the circuit to run for varying times at low pressures. The lower the pressure, the shorter the time the compressor can run. This time is calculated as follows: Freeze error = Low Evaporator Pressure Unload – Evaporator Pressure Freeze time = 70 – 0.906 x freeze error, limited to a range of 20-70 seconds When the evaporator pressure goes below the Low Evaporator Pressure Unload set point, a timer starts. If this timer exceeds the freeze time, then a freezestat trip occurs. If the evaporator pressure rises to the unload set point or higher, and freeze time has not been exceeded, the timer will reset. Trigger 2 - The alarm will trigger if Evaporator Press is less than 0 kPa (0 psi) for longer than one second while the circuit state is Run Trigger 3 - The alarm will trigger if Evap Press is less than 0 kPa (0 psi) for longer than 5 seconds while the circuit state is anything other than Run For any trigger condition, the alarm cannot trigger if the evaporator pressure sensor fault is active or the CC1 module communication is not working. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI if evap press is above 0 kPa (0 psi)
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: High Condenser Pressure (Circuit level) - Trigger: Saturated Condenser Temp > Max Saturated Condenser Value for time longer than High Condenser Pressure Delay set point. Cannot trigger if CC1 module commination is not working. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the unit controller HMI if Saturated Condenser Temp ≤ Max Saturated Condenser Value
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Mechanical High Pressure Switch (Circuit level) - Trigger: At least 12 seconds elapsed since controller booted and compressor VFD reports Safe Stop alarm or warning. The alarm is bit 30 in the Alarm word and the warning is bit 30 in the Warning word from the VFD. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI. When alarm is cleared, command to reset alarms should be sent to VFD
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: High Discharge Temperature (Circuit level) - Trigger: The following are true for one second: Circuit state is Start, Run, or Shutdown Discharge Temperature > High Discharge Temperature set point discharge temperature sensor fault is not active. Action taken: Normal shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or via BAS command
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: High Oil Pressure Difference (Circuit level) - Trigger: Circuit is in the Run state and Oil Pressure Difference > High Oil Pressure Difference value for a time longer than High Oil Pressure Difference Delay set point High Oil Pressure Difference value is calculated as shown Figure 27 Operating PD = Condenser Pressure – Evaporator Pressure Minimum for High Oil Pressure Difference = High Oil Pressure Difference set point Maximum for High Oil Pressure Difference = High Oil Pressure Difference set point + 100kPa. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller unit controller HMI or via BAS command
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Oil Feed Loss (Circuit level) - Trigger: The following are true for 20 second: Oil Presence Sensor setting is ‘Yes’ Compressor is running Oil Presence Sensor input is off. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: High Motor Temperature (Circuit level) - Trigger: Compressor VFD reports motor overheat alarm, which is bit 7 in the Alarm word from the VFD. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller unit controller HMI when compressor has been off for at least 5 minutes. When the alarm is cleared in the unit controller, the command to clear the fault in the VFD will be sent
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: No Pressure Change At Start (Circuit level) - Trigger: After start of compressor, at least a 7 kPa drop in evaporator pressure or 25 kPa increase in condenser pressure has not occurred within 40 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller unit controller HMI or BAS command
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: No Pressure At Start (Circuit level) - Trigger: All of the following must be true to trigger: Circuit start requested Either Evaporator Pressure or Condenser Pressure are less than 35 kPa (5.1 psi). Action taken: Abort start of circuit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller unit controller HMI or BAS command
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Low Discharge Superheat (Circuit level) - Trigger: If both of the following are true for at least 30 minutes, the alarm is triggered: Circuit state is not Off DSH < Low DSH Limit set point. Action taken: Normal shutdown of unit and lock out from running on the third occurrence
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or via BAS command
faultCodes.notes: Prior occurrences are logged as events; the third within 2 hours triggers the alarm.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Low Pressure Ratio (Circuit level) - Trigger: Circuit state is Run and pressure ratio < 1.3 for a time > Low Pressure Ratio Delay set point. This alarm is actually triggered on the third occurrence of the above conditions within 2 hours. Prior occurrences are events. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running on the third occurrence.
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or via BAS command.
faultCodes.notes: Prior occurrences are logged as events; the third within 2 hours triggers the alarm.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: High Compressor VFD Output Current (Circuit level) - Trigger: This alarm will trigger when all of the following are true: compressor is running Motor Current > Max Motor Current x 1.1 for at least 2 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or via BAS command.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: High Compressor VFD Input Current (Circuit level) - Trigger: This alarm will trigger when all of the following are true for at least 5 seconds: unit mode is Ice compressor is running VFD Input Current > VFD Primary RLA set point x 1.05 VFD Primary RLA set point is part of the unit configuration. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or via BAS command.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Comm Failure (Circuit level) - Trigger: Communication with the compressor VFD has failed. This means that either a modbus configuration error has occurred, or a modbus command has failed in 10 consecutive loops of the modbus commands for this node address. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or via BAS command if communication has been restored for 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Fault (Circuit level) - Trigger: Trip flag from VFD is set and alarm flags for the following VFD alarms are NOT set: Earth fault High control card temperature Control word timeout High Motor Temp DC link undervoltage DC link overvoltage Mains Phase Loss Motor Phase Loss Safe Stop The above conditions are required for one second to trigger the alarm. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or via BAS command. When alarm is cleared, command to reset alarms should be sent to VFD.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Over Voltage (Circuit level) - Trigger: DC link over voltage alarm flag is set in compressor VFD for at least one second. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm will automatically reset when ‘DC link over voltage’ alarm flag is not set for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Under Voltage (Circuit level) - Trigger: DC link under voltage alarm flag is set in compressor VFD. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm will automatically reset when ‘DC link under voltage’ alarm flag is not set for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor Motor Phase Loss (Circuit level) - Trigger: Any of the following Compressor VFD alarm flags is set: Motor phase U is missing Motor phase V is missing Motor phase W is missing. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm will automatically reset when none of the motor phase loss alarm flags are set for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Mains Phase Loss (Circuit level) - Trigger: Compressor VFD sets the ‘Mains Phase Loss’ alarm flag for at least one second or the ‘Mains Failure’ warning flag for at least 2.5 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command if none of the trigger condition are true
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Motor Earth Leakage (Circuit level) - Trigger: Compressor VFD sets the ‘Earth Fault’ alarm flag. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm will automatically reset when the Earth Fault flag is not set for at least 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor VFD Control Card Temp High (Circuit level) - Trigger: Compressor is running and VFD sets the Ctrl Card Temp alarm flag. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command if ‘Ctrl Card Temp’ alarm flag is not set for at least one minute
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor Multiple Start Failure (Circuit level) - Trigger: This alarm is actually triggered on the third occurrence of the below conditions within 2 hours. Prior occurrences are events. All of the following must be true to trigger: Compressor Run command is on Compressor VFD Communication Failure is not active Either VFD Actual Speed = 0 for more than 15 seconds OR VFD Actual Speed < 14hz for more than 30 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command
faultCodes.notes: Printed as "Cn CompMultiStartFail"; the manual's examples use circuit 1.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Evaporator Pressure Sensor Fault (Circuit level) - Trigger: Trigger if all of the following are true: UC communication with CC1 module is OK sensor input voltage is less than 400mv and, for at least 1 second sensor input voltage is more than 4600mv for at least one second and compressor running for at least 90 seconds. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command if sensor input voltage is 400mv to 4600mv for at least 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Condenser Pressure Sensor Fault (Circuit level) - Trigger: Trigger if all of the following are true: UC communication with CC1 module is OK sensor input voltage is less than 400mv or more than 4600mv for at least 1 second. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command if sensor input voltage is 400mv to 4600mv for at least 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Oil Pressure Sensor Fault (Circuit level) - Trigger: Trigger any time sensor input voltage is less than 400mv or more than 4600mv and UC communication with CC1 module is OK, for at least 1 second. Action taken: Normal shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command if sensor input voltage is 400mv to 4600mv for at least 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Suction Temp Sensor Fault (Circuit level) - Trigger: Trigger if UC communication with EEXV1 module is OK and any of the following are true for at least 1 second: Sensor input value < 340 Ω Sensor input value > 300 kΩ Sensor reliability reported by control system ≠ ‘No Fault’. Action taken: Rapid shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command if sensor input value is 340 Ω to 300 kΩ and sensor reliability = ‘No Fault’ for at least 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Discharge Temp Sensor Fault (Circuit level) - Trigger: Trigger if UC communication with CC1 module is OK and any of the following are true for at least 1 second: Sensor input value < 340 Ω Sensor input value > 300 kΩ Sensor reliability reported by control system ≠ ‘No Fault’. Action taken: Normal shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command if sensor input value is 340 Ω to 300 kΩ and sensor reliability = ‘No Fault’ for at least 5 seconds
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Liquid Line Temperature Sensor Fault (Circuit level) - Trigger: Trigger if UC communication with EEXV1 module is OK and any of the following are true for at least 1 second: Sensor input value < 340 Ω Sensor input value > 300 kΩ Sensor reliability reported by control system ≠ ‘No Fault’. Action taken: Normal shutdown of unit and lock out from running
checks: Reset: This alarm can be cleared manually via the Unit Controller HMI or BAS command if sensor input value is 340 Ω to 300 kΩ and sensor reliability = ‘No Fault’ for at least 5 seconds.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.meaning: Power Loss While Running (Circuit level) - Trigger: Circuit is running when controller loses power. Action taken: None
checks: Reset: N/A
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV water-cooled screw chiller, Operation > Description of Alarms, pp.42-48

faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.notes: Resets when evaporator pressure rises at least 14 kPa (2.03 psi) above the Hold set point.

faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.meaning: Low Pressure Ratio - event (log only, no shutdown): event on the 1st and 2nd occurrence within 2 h of pressure ratio < 1.3 for longer than the Low Pressure Ratio Delay; the 3rd triggers the alarm
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

faultCodes.meaning: Compressor Start Failure - event (log only, no shutdown): event on the 1st and 2nd occurrence within 2 h with the run command on and VFD speed = 0 for > 15 s or < 14 Hz for > 30 s; the 3rd triggers Compressor Multiple Start Failure
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied IOM 1264-5 (Aug 2026) Navigator WWV/TWV, Events pp.48-50

diagnosticTips: Alarms clear from the HMI or BAS (LON nviClearAlarms, BACnet ClearAlarms) only when the cause no longer exists; cycling controller power clears alarms; no password is needed (IOM 1264-5 p.41).

The event log holds 50 entries ('+' = occurrence, '-' = clear); export with 'Log Export to SD'. The alarm snapshot log is erased if a unit configuration setting is changed and the controller is rebooted - export it before reconfiguring (IOM 1264-5).
Flow loss while running auto-resets the first two times each day; the third occurrence needs a manual reset (IOM 1264-5).
Low evaporator pressure freezestat: freeze time = 70 - 0.906 x freeze error, limited to 20-70 s (IOM 1264-5).

controls.name: Daikin Applied MicroTech chiller BACnet alarm code numbers (AVWarningAlarmCode / AVProblemAlarmCode / AVFaultAlarmCode)
controls.description: Numeric alarm codes a BAS reads from a Daikin Applied MicroTech chiller unit controller over BACnet (ED 15120-12, Tables 13-15): Warning class AV:903, Problem class AV:904, Fault class AV:905 (alarm indices AV:900-902). The BAS sees only the highest active code per class; 0 = no alarms. Covers the chiller models listed on the ED cover (Trailblazer AGZ/AMZ, Pathfinder AWS/AWV, ADS, Magnitude WME-B, Navigator WWV/TWV and others); the table does not say which model raises each code (IGV / MBC / rotor pump items are Magnitude, slide position / oil feed are screw-chiller items). Codes 48163 and 48195 each have three descriptions in the table, merged here. The ED was parsed from a two-column PDF layout; spot-check unusual codes against the PDF.
appliesTo: Daikin Applied MicroTech chiller unit controllers on BACnet MS/TP or IP (Trailblazer, Pathfinder, Navigator, Magnitude WME-B and others per ED 15120-12)

diagnosticTips: Example: AVProblemAlarmCode = 16642 means START INHIBITED - Ambient Temperature Low (low ambient lockout is annunciated, not an alarm) (ED 15120-12).
Clear alarms from the BAS with BACnet ClearAlarms (BV:8) or LON nviClearAlarms; ED 15120-12 lists alarms that cannot be cleared from the network.
For the HMI text, trigger and reset of an alarm, look up the chiller family platform (Pathfinder, Trailblazer AGZ-F, Navigator, Magnitude).

controls.name: Daikin Applied MicroTech unit controller - Rebel DPS (R-32) rooftop alarms, inverter / outdoor fan codes and events (OM 1382-2)
controls.description: MicroTech unit controller for the R-32 Rebel DPS commercial packaged rooftop (OM 1382-2, Dec 2025, app version 2506036302). The HMI shows 'Name: Type' (e.g. 'Dirty Filter: Warning'); code field = display name plus the alarm number, e.g. 'Hi DL Temp_1: Problem (120)', so either finds it. Warnings 24-58, Problems 62-199, Faults 208-252. Includes the A2L leak alarms 133 Refrigerant Leak Problem and 134 Refrigerant Sensor Problem, the inverter compressor (Table 104) and outdoor fan (Table 105) Daikin fault codes with their HMI code text, and events / standby events (info) with the event troubleshooting field actions. Severity: Fault = shutdown (manual clear); Problem = lockout where the description requires a manual clear or locks out compressors, otherwise warning; Warning = warning. '0 No Active ...' rows omitted. The older R-410A Rebel alarms (OM 920 / OM 1141) are on the 'microtech-iii' platform.

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 24 "Main Filter: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the unit Main filter bank is dirty. The filter is considered dirty when the FilterSw1 (PSMF) across the Main filter bank is in alarm continuously for 60 seconds or Filter press 1 or 2 analog inputs is above the HiFltPress1Spt continuously for 60 seconds.
checks: This alarm requires a manual clear.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 101

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 34 "Exh Fan: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the unit Exh Fan status is not as expected. This warning occurs only on units equipped with exhaust fans when the EF Status is expected to be true and it is false for at least 30 seconds.
checks: This alarm will automatically clear if status changes to the expected vale.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 101

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 50 "Over Econo: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the unit is economizing when it should not be will be generated whenever the outdoor air dampers are stuck open while operating in the Econo or Cooling operating state. The dampers are considered stuck open when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is less than the calibrated damper end switch closed value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value dropping (and remaining) below the calibrated damper end switch open value (less the calibrated maximum switch differential). The over economizing warning will also be generated if the Econo Status is Enabled when the OAT is greater than the Max OAT Limit setting (default 75F). Exception: This case is ignored when the economizer enable decision is being controlled by a network input or when the economizer changeover method (EconChgovr) is set for OAT/RAT dry bulb comparison (OAT/ RAT). NOTE: The damper end switch open (PosSwOpen%), Minimum switch differential (MinSwDiff), damper end switch closed (PosSwClose%) and maximum switch differential (MaxSwDiff) values are determined during the OAD damper end switch calibration process.
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 101

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 52 "Under Econo: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the unit is not economizing when it should be will be generated whenever the outdoor air dampers are stuck closed while operating in the Econo or Cooling state. The dampers are considered stuck closed when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is greater than the calibrated damper end switch open value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value rising above the calibrated damper end switch closed value (plus the calibrated minimum switch differential). The under economizing alarm will also be generated if the Econo Status is not Enabled when the OAT is less than the Min OAT Limit setting (default 70F). Exception: This case is ignored when the economizer enable decision is being controlled by a network input or when the economizer changeover method (EconChgovr) is set for OAT/RAT dry bulb comparison (OAT/ RAT). The under economizing alarm will also be generated when the OAT sensor is unreliable or the RAT sensor is unreliable while the OAT is below the Min OAT Limit setting (default 70F) and the economizer changeover method (EconChgovr) is set for OAT/RAT dry bulb comparison (OAT/ RAT). NOTE: The damper end switch open (PosSwOpen%), Minimum switch differential (MinSwDiff), damper end switch closed (PosSwClose%) and maximum switch differential (MaxSwDiff) values are determined during the OAD damper end switch calibration process.
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 101

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 54 "Excess OA: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the unit is delivering excessive outdoor air will be generated whenever the outdoor air dampers are stuck open. The outdoor dampers are considered stuck open when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is less than the calibrated damper end switch closed value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value dropping (and remaining) below the calibrated damper end switch open value (less the calibrated maximum switch differential). The excess outdoor air warning will also be generated while operating in the Econo or Cooling state when the Econo Status is Enabled and the OAT is greater than the Max OAT Limit setting (default 75F). Exception: This case is ignored when the economizer enable decision is being controlled by a network input or when the economizer changeover method (EconChgovr) is set for OAT/RAT dry bulb comparison (OAT/ RAT). NOTE: The damper end switch open (PosSwOpen%), Minimum switch differential (MinSwDiff), damper end switch closed (PosSwClose%) and maximum switch differential (MaxSwDiff) values are determined during the OAD damper end switch calibration process.
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer valid.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 101

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 56 "OADStuck: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the outdoor air dampers are stuck and not modulating will be generated whenever the damper are stuck open or stuck closed. The dampers are considered stuck open when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is less than the calibrated damper end switch closed value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value dropping (and remaining) below the calibrated damper end switch open value (less the calibrated maximum switch differential). The dampers are considered stuck closed when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is greater than the calibrated damper end switch open value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value rising above the calibrated damper end switch closed value (plus the calibrated minimum switch differential). The damper stuck warning will also be generated when the damper end switch operation is unreliable. The ends switches are considered unreliable when the end switch input remains closed when the damper command value is between the calibrated end switch closed and open values (plus and minus the calibrated minimum and maximum switch differentials).
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 101

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 58 "ERWheel: Warning" - Some units are equipped with a wheel rotation detection capability. This is present if the wheel is using an ECM motor. The ERWheel Warning flag is present if the wheel rotation is not detected.
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 101

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 62 "Condensate Overflow Problem" - The condensate overflow problem occurs when the condensate overflow sensor digital input has been open for 10 seconds or more. As a result, the cooling system will be disabled.
checks: The alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 101 "MHGRhtVlv1: Problem" - The MHGRhtVlv1 Problem occurs when MHGRht valve synchronization sequence has started and is not completed successfully. As a result, the Dehumidification operation will be disabled unless primary heat back up reheat is available.
checks: This problem requires a Manual clear of the alarm.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 105 "DRT1 Sensor: Problem" - This alarm occurs when the DRT1 (Discharge Refrigerant Temperature) sensor input is shorted or open circuited for the Sensor Alarm Delay (default 30 seconds). It can also occur when the variable speed compressor is off and the input is above 329°F or the compressor has been off for 20 minutes and the input is below -4°F. When this alarm is active compressor cooling operation is disabled.
checks: The alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 107 "4WV1 Problem" - The 4WV problem alarm is triggered during compressorized heating or cooling when the differential between the PTD (Discharge Pressure Transducer) and PTS (Suction Pressure Transducer) drops below 57 psi for more than 15 minutes. The PTD and PTS differential is ignored during defrost state when the compressor enters initialization state.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 109 "ProtIntrlck: Problem" - When configured for refrigeration only control there is generic interlock digital input defined that must be made to allow cooling operation (for an airflow switch for example). If the field calls for cooling but this input in not made you end up with the ProtIntrlck: Problem alarm.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 110 "VCmp1: Problem" - If the Variable Speed Compressor on Circuit 1 is enabled and commanded to run for 30 seconds but the controller fails to receive the variable speed run verification input the variable speed compressor is cycled OFF (a variable speed Compressor Emergency Stop Control Event is logged) for 5 secondes and then back on. The variable speed compressor is then ramped to 45%. If this occurs 5 times in a 100 min period the variable speed compressor is shut off and the VCmp1 Problem alarm is generated.
checks: This alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 115 "SRT Sensor 1: Problem" - This alarm occurs when the SRT1 Sensor (Suction Refrigerant Temperature) sensor input is shorted or open for the Sensor Alarm Delay (default 30s) It can also occur when the variable speed compressor is off and the input is above 329°F.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 120 "Hi DL Temp_1: Problem" - Normal compressor control is limited when a high discharge line temperature conditions occur. If the variable speed compressor is operating and the discharge line temperature is greater than 250F for 15 seconds a High Discharge Line Temperature Event is generated and the variable speed compressor capacity is reduced every 15 seconds until the discharge line temperature falls below 220F. If the discharge line temperature is above 250F continuously for 3 minutes the variable speed compressor is stopped and a High Discharge Line Temperature problem alarm is generated.
checks: The alarm must be manually cleared.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 125 "Exp Valve 1: Problem" - Exp Valve 1 Problem indicates the EVI valve resync Counter is greater than or equal to 4 or that EVI synchronization sequence is not completed within 60 seconds.
checks: This alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 130 "OA Fan 1: Problem" - Outdoor Fan 1 Problem indicates
faultCodes.notes: Description is truncated in the manual as printed.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 133 "Refrigerant Leak Problem" - The refrigerant leak problem occurs when a refrigerant leak sensor detects a refrigerant concentration above 15% of the refrigerant lower flammability level. As a result, compressors will be locked out and the supply fan speed may be overridden. See “A2L Detection and Mitigation” on page 175 for details.
checks: The alarm must be cleared manually once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.notes: A2L (R-32) refrigerant leak detection alarm.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 134 "Refrigerant Sensor Problem" - The refrigerant sensor problem occurs when a refrigerant leak sensor is determined to be faulty by the leak detection control board. As a result, compressors will be locked out and the supply fan speed may be overridden. See “A2L Detection and Mitigation” on page 175 for details.
checks: The alarm must be cleared manually once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.notes: A2L (R-32) refrigerant leak detection alarm.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 135 "PTS1 Sensor: Problem" - PTS1 or 2 Sensor Problem indicates the a sensor malfunction. This alarm is present when the following is true for 30 seconds where PTS<96kPa and the CircState is not in pumpdown or where the following is true for 30 minutes; the SSH1-SSHSpt >20.0F, DSH1<5.0F, and EVI Pos >95%.
checks: This alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action has been taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 140 "PTD1 Sensor: Problem" - This alarm occurs when either the circuit 1 discharge line pressure inputs (PTD1) remains above 705 psi for 10 seconds. When this alarm is active compressor cooling operation is disabled.
checks: The alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 145 "Lo Charge 1: Problem" - The Lo Charge 1 Problem alarm indicates a condition that is consistent with a low refrigerant charge on circuit 1. This alarm occurs when the suction super heat is more than 20F greater than the setpoint, the expansion valve is >95% open for more than 30 min.
checks: This alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action has been taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 150 "ChargeLoss 1: Problem" - The ChargeLoss 1 or 2 Problem alarm indicates a condition where the charge is not present. This alarm occurs when the suction superheat is more than 20F greater than the setpoint, the expansion valve is >95% open and the HDRT is > 150.0F for 30 minutes.
checks: This alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action has been taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 155 "VCmp1LoDSH: Problem" - The VCmp1LoDSH Problem alarm indicates a condition where the variable compressor has been disabled due to 3 lo discharge super heat events.
checks: This alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action has been taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 160 "Lo Press 1: Problem" - The Lo Press 1 Problem alarm indicates a condition a low pressure condition on a circuit. This condition occurs when the low pressure switch input has been in alarm (open) position for longer than the LP Pressure Switch Delay (Default = 2 Seconds).
checks: This alarm will automatically reset if the Lo Pressure Event has not occurred more than 4 times in 24 hours.
Otherwise a manual clear is required once action has been taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 165 "Hi Press 1: Problem" - Normal variable speed compressor control is limited when a high discharge pressure conditions occur on the variable speed compressor circuit. If the variable speed compressor is operating and the discharge pressure (PTD) is greater than 525 PSI, a High Pressure Unloading Control Event is generated and the variable speed compressor is slowed every 10 seconds until either the discharge pressure falls to less than 525 PSI or remains higher than 575 PSI for 10 minutes. If the discharge pressure is above 575 PSI for 10 minutes the variable speed compressor is shut off and a High Pressure Problem alarm is generated. If the OAT is below 45F at the time the variable speed compressor is shut off immediately and a High Pressure Problem alarm is generated anytime the discharge pressure rises above 575 PSI.
checks: The alarm must be manually cleared.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 170 "Lo Press Diff 1: Problem" - The Lo Pressure Diff Problem alarm indicates a condition where the differential pressure between the high and low side of the refrigeration circuit becomes too low for proper oil lubrication in the inverter compressor. This alarm occurs when the counter exceeds 3 events in a 45 min period.
checks: Alarm requires manual reset once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 175 "HiVCmpTmp 1: Problem" - The HiVCmpTmp Problem alarm indicates a condition where the variable speed compressor exceeds its maximum temperature of 248F for 5 seconds.
checks: The alarm automatically resets after 100 min if the condition does not occur again.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 180 "VCmpTSnsr 1: Problem" - The VCmpTSnsr Problem alarm indicates a condition where the compressor temp sensor is present and shorted.
checks: The alarm requires manual clearing after manually cleared.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 185 "VCmp1HiDSH: Problem" - The VCmp1HiDSH Problem alarm indicates a condition where the discharge super heat is detected and the compressor is forced to standby to prevent the variable speed compressor from operating under high motor, discharge port or oil temperature conditions.
checks: The alarm requires manual clearing.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 190 "IFB1 Comm: Problem (VCmp1)" - The IFB1 Comm Problem alarm indicates a condition where the HP switches are normal and the IFB comm module has a loss of communication.
checks: This alarm automatically clears when comms are re-established unless there are 5 occurrences in a 100 minute period.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 192 "EFT/LCT Snsr: Problem" - This alarm occurs when the Entering Fan Temperature/Leaving Coil Temperature sensor is present and either shorted or open circuited for longer than the Sensor Alarm Delay (Default = 30 seconds). When this alarm occurs the unit continues to operate however dehumidification operation is disabled until the sensor becomes reliable. The maximum DAT limit function associated with gas or electric heat is also disabled until the sensor becomes reliable.
faultCodes.notes: Control Type: ZTC, DTC or 1ZnVAV.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 193 "RAT Sensor: Problem" - If the return air temperature sensor (RAT) is present and either shorted or open circuited for longer than the Sensor Alarm Delay (default is 30 seconds), the Return Air Sensor problem occurs.
checks: When the RAT Sensor problem occurs, the unit continues to operate with the following modifications: Cooling Reset and Heating Resets revert to None if they are set to Return and Control temperature Source reverts from return to space temperature if a space temperature is present and reliable.
When the alarm condition is no longer present, the RAT sensor problem automatically clears.
faultCodes.notes: Control Type: ZTC, DTC or 1ZnVAV.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 194 "Space Sensor 1: Problem" - If the space air temperature sensor is present and either shorted or open circuited for longer than the Sensor Alarm Delay (default is 30 seconds), the space sensor problem occurs.
checks: When the space air temperature sensor problem occurs, the unit continues to operate with the following modifications: Cooling Reset and Heating Resets revert to None if they are set to space and control temperature source reverts from space to return temperature if a return temperature is present and reliable.
When the alarm condition is no longer present, the space sensor problem automatically clears.
faultCodes.notes: Control Type: ZTC, DTC or 1ZnVAV.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 195 "Space Sensor 2: Problem"
faultCodes.notes: Control Type: ZTC, DTC or 1ZnVAV. The manual prints no description for this alarm; see Space Sensor 1 (194) for the sensor logic.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 196 "Space Sensor 3: Problem"
faultCodes.notes: Control Type: ZTC, DTC or 1ZnVAV. The manual prints no description for this alarm; see Space Sensor 1 (194) for the sensor logic.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 197 "OAT Sensor: Problem" - If the outside air temperature sensor (OAT) is present, a valid OAT value is not provided via the network and the local OAT sensor is either shorted or open circuited for longer than the Sensor Alarm Delay (default is 30 seconds), the Outside Air Sensor problem occurs.
checks: When the OAT Sensor problem occurs, the unit continues to operate with the following modifications: Heating is not locked out due to high OAT, Cooling is not locked out due to low OAT, Cooling Reset and Heating Reset revert to none if they are set to OAT and Economizer is locked out due to high OAT.
When the alarm condition is no longer present, the OAT Sensor problem automatically clears.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 198 "Freeze: Problem" - When a unit is equipped with chilled water, hot water, or steam coil, the Freeze problem occurs when the optional freezestat contacts open as a result of detecting an abnormally low water or steam coil temperature while the fans are off. When the Freeze problem occurs, the controller opens the chilled water and heating valves, and sets a 10-minute timer. When the 10-minute timer expires, the controller checks the freezestat input again. If the freezestat contacts are closed the valves close. This continues while the unit remains off. This feature protects the coil(s) and allows the system to start normally when an occupied command is received.
checks: If the freezestat contacts are still open, the valves remain open, and the 10-minute timer resets.
Whenever the freezestat closes the Freeze problem automatically clears.
faultCodes.notes: Control Type: ZTC, DTC or 1ZnVAV.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 199 "Heat Fail: Problem" - When a unit is equipped with a Natural Gas or Propane Burner and the modulating burner Modbus status is Fault for 20 seconds.
checks: This automatically clears once communications are reestablished.
faultCodes.notes: Control Type: ZTC, DTC or 1ZnVAV.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 102

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 208 "Airflow: Fault" - The Airflow Fault occurs when the fan does not provide flow feedback after 5 start tries.
checks: This requires a manual clear once corrective action has been taken.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 212 "Lo Disch Temp: Fault" - The Lo Disch Occurs If the unit is not in the operating state and the discharge air temperature is less than the Low Discharge Temperature Limit (Default = 40°F) for longer than 35 seconds and the supply fan has been on for longer than the LowDAT temperature alarm delay (Default = 6 minutes), the Low Discharge Air Temperature fault occurs. When the Low Discharge Air Temperature fault occurs, the unit is shut down.
checks: It remains shut down until the Low Discharge Air Temperature fault is manually cleared through the unit keypad or via a network signal.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 216 "Hi Disch Temp: Fault" - If the discharge air temperature is greater than the High Discharge Temperature Limit (Default = 170°F) and the supply fan has been on for longer than the Temperature Alarm Delay (Default = 35 seconds), the High Discharge Air Temperature fault occurs. When the High Discharge Air Temperature fault occurs, the unit is shut down.
checks: It remains shut down until the High Discharge Air Temperature fault is manually cleared through the unit keypad or via a network signal.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 220 "Hi Return Tmp: Fault" - If the return air temperature is greater than the Return Air Temperature Limit (Default = 120°F) and the supply fan has been on for longer than the temperature alarm delay (Default= 35 seconds), the High Return Air Temperature fault occurs. When the High Return Air Temperature fault occurs, the unit is shut down.
checks: It remains shut down until the High Return Air Temperature fault is manually cleared through the unit keypad or via a network signal.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 224 "Duct Hi Limit: Fault" - If the unit is variable air volume, the contacts of the duct high pressure limit control (DHL) open, and the unit state is not Off or Startup, the Duct High Limit fault occurs. When the Duct High Limit fault occurs, the unit is shut down.
checks: The unit remains shut down until the Duct High Limit fault is manually cleared through the unit keypad or via a network signal.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 228 "Disch Tmp: Fault" - If the discharge air temperature sensor (DAT) is open or short circuited for longer than the Sensor Alarm Delay (Default= 30 seconds), the Discharge Air Sensor fault occurs. When the Discharge Air Sensor fault occurs, the unit is shut down.
checks: It remains shut down until the Discharge Air Sensor fault is manually cleared through the unit keypad or via a network signal.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 244 "Control Temp: Fault" - If the temperature sensor (ZNT1, RAT, OAT, MAT) selected as the control temperature source is not reliable for longer than the Sensor Alarm Delay (Default= 30 seconds), a Control Temperature Fault occurs. When the Control Temperature Fault occurs, the unit is shut down.
checks: It remains shut down until the Control Temperature Fault is manually cleared through the unit keypad or via a network signal.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 250 "Emerg Stop: Fault" - An Emergency Stop Fault will occur if either of the following conditions is true: Emergency Stop Input in the Alarm (Open) condition Or The Net Emrg Ovrd input is set to Off via a network signal or the keypad/display.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 252 "Freeze: Fault" - When a unit is equipped with chilled water, hot water, or steam coil, the Freeze Fault occurs when the optional freezestat contacts open as a result of detecting an abnormally low water or steam coil temperature while the fans are running. When the Freeze fault occurs, the controller shuts down the fans, opens the chilled water, economizer, and heating valves and set a 10-minute timer. When the 10-minute timer expires, the controller checks the freezestat input again. If the freezestat contacts are closed the pump output is de-energized and the valves close.
checks: If the freezestat contacts are still open the pump output remains energized, the valves remain open, and the 10-minute timer resets.
This continues until the fault is manually cleared through the keypad or via a network signal.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1382-2 (Dec 2025) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel DPS (R-32), Service Menus Table 103

diagnosticTips: A2L leak alarms: 133 Refrigerant Leak Problem = a leak sensor detects more than 15% of the refrigerant LFL - compressors lock out and the supply fan may be overridden; 134 Refrigerant Sensor Problem = the leak sensor itself is faulty. Both need a manual clear after the cause is fixed (OM 1382-2).

Alarm 120 high discharge line temperature: above 250°F for 15 s an event logs and capacity steps down every 15 s until the line is below 220°F; above 250°F continuously for 3 min the compressor stops and the Problem needs a manual clear (OM 1382-2).
Alarm 107 4-way valve: triggers when the PTD - PTS differential is below 57 psi for more than 15 min during compressor heating or cooling; ignored in defrost (OM 1382-2).
Alarm 110 VCmp1: if the run-verification input is missing after 30 s the compressor is cycled off 5 s, back on and ramped to 45%; five occurrences in 100 min lock it out (OM 1382-2).

Alarm Out relay per class (Table 110 defaults): Faults = Fast flash, Problems = Slow, Warnings = Off. Fault defaults: Hi DAT 170°F, Lo DAT 40°F, Hi RAT 120°F, temperature alarm delay 35 s, sensor alarm delay 30 s.

Event Troubleshooting (Table 109): the event names printed in the table do not match their descriptions - read by description (e.g. low subcooling = low charge, dirty condenser coil, condenser fan motor; high subcooling = overcharge).

controls.name: Daikin Applied MicroTech unit controller - Rebel Applied DPSA / DHSA / DAHA (R-32) rooftop alarms and events (OM 1373-2)
controls.description: MicroTech unit controller for the R-32 Rebel Applied rooftop (DPSA, DHSA heat pump, DAHA air handler), OM 1373-2 (Apr 2026, app version 2506036302). Up to three circuits with fixed plus variable compressors, so many alarms come in pairs or triples (printed as '110 or 111 VCmp1/VCmp2'); each is listed separately here with the shared description. Code field = display name plus alarm number, e.g. 'VCmp2: Problem (111)'. Adds the 64-92 fixed-compressor temperature / sensor problems, DFT1-3 defrost sensors, 25 Final Filter warning, 61 High Dewpoint Cooling Disabled and 205 HiDptClgDsbld fault; 133 / 134 are the A2L leak and leak-sensor problems keyed to A2LState (Alarm, Mitig, Testing, Fault, NoComm). Events and standby events are info. Severity as on the Rebel DPS platform. Refrigeration-only (ROC) manuals OM 1401-1, OM 1355, OM 1407 and OM 1263-2 have no numbered alarm table and are not transcribed.
appliesTo: Daikin Applied Rebel Applied DPSA / DHSA / DAHA (R-32)

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 50 "Over Econo: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the unit is economizing when it should not be will be generated whenever the outdoor air dampers are stuck open while operating in the Econo or Cooling operating state. The dampers are considered stuck open when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is less than the calibrated damper end switch closed value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value dropping (and remaining) below the calibrated damper end switch open value (less the calibrated maximum switch differential). The over economizing warning will also be generated if the Econo Status is Enabled when the OAT is greater than the Max OAT Limit setting (default 75F). Exception: This case is ignored when the economizer enable decision is being controlled by a network input or when the economizer changeover method (EconChgovr) is set for OAT/RAT dry bulb comparison (OAT/RAT). NOTE: The damper end switch open (PosSwOpen%), Minimum switch differential (MinSwDiff), damper end switch closed (PosSwClose%) and maximum switch differential (MaxSwDiff) values are determined during the OAD damper end switch calibration process.
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1373-2 (Apr 2026) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel Applied DPSA/DHSA/DAHA (R-32), Service Menus Table 106

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 52 "Under Econo: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the unit is not economizing when it should be will be generated whenever the outdoor air dampers are stuck closed while operating in the Econo or Cooling state. The dampers are considered stuck closed when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is greater than the calibrated damper end switch open value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value rising above the calibrated damper end switch closed value (plus the calibrated minimum switch differential). The under economizing alarm will also be generated if the Econo Status is not Enabled when the OAT is less than the Min OAT Limit setting (default 70F). Exception: This case is ignored when the economizer enable decision is being controlled by a network input or when the economizer changeover method (EconChgovr) is set for OAT/RAT dry bulb comparison (OAT/RAT). The under economizing alarm will also be generated when the OAT sensor is unreliable or the RAT sensor is unreliable while the OAT is below the Min OAT Limit setting (default 70F) and the economizer changeover method (EconChgovr) is set for OAT/RAT dry bulb comparison (OAT/RAT). NOTE: The damper end switch open (PosSwOpen%), Minimum switch differential (MinSwDiff), damper end switch closed (PosSwClose%) and maximum switch differential (MaxSwDiff) values are determined during the OAD damper end switch calibration process.
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1373-2 (Apr 2026) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel Applied DPSA/DHSA/DAHA (R-32), Service Menus Table 106

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 54 "Excess OA: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the unit is delivering excessive outdoor air will be generated whenever the outdoor air dampers are stuck open. The outdoor dampers are considered stuck open when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is less than the calibrated damper end switch closed value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value dropping (and remaining) below the calibrated damper end switch open value (less the calibrated maximum switch differential). The excess outdoor air warning will also be generated while operating in the Econo or Cooling state when the Econo Status is Enabled and the OAT is greater than the Max OAT Limit setting (default 75F). Exception: This case is ignored when the economizer enable decision is being controlled by a network input or when the economizer changeover method (EconChgovr) is set for OAT/RAT dry bulb comparison (OAT/ RAT). NOTE: The damper end switch open (PosSwOpen%), Minimum switch differential (MinSwDiff), damper end switch closed (PosSwClose%) and maximum switch differential (MaxSwDiff) values are determined during the OAD damper end switch calibration process.
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer valid.

faultCodes.meaning: Warning alarm 56 "OADStuck: Warning" - A warning alarm indicating the outdoor air dampers are stuck and not modulating will be generated whenever the damper are stuck open or stuck closed. The dampers are considered stuck open when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is less than the calibrated damper end switch closed value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value dropping (and remaining) below the calibrated damper end switch open value (less the calibrated maximum switch differential). The dampers are considered stuck closed when either of the following abnormal situations occurs: The damper command value is greater than the calibrated damper end switch open value continuously for 180 seconds yet the outside air damper end switch input remains open. The damper end switch input does not change from closed to open with 30 seconds of the damper command value rising above the calibrated damper end switch closed value (plus the calibrated minimum switch differential). The damper stuck warning will also be generated when the damper end switch operation is unreliable. The ends switches are considered unreliable when the end switch input remains closed when the damper command value is between the calibrated end switch closed and open values (plus and minus the calibrated minimum and maximum switch differentials).
checks: The alarm will automatically clear when the conditions causing the alarm are no longer present.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1373-2 (Apr 2026) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel Applied DPSA/DHSA/DAHA (R-32), Service Menus Table 106

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 70 "C1DRT3 Sensor Problem" - This alarm occurs when both of the following are true for longer than the Temperature Alarm Delay (default 30 seconds): • The C1DRT3 or C1DRT5 sensor is present • Any of the following are true: — The C1DRT3 or C1DRT5 sensor is shorted — All the following are true for at least 60 seconds: a. faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 110 "VCmp1: Problem" - If the Variable Speed Compressor on Circuit 1 or Circuit 2 is enabled and commanded to run for 30 seconds but the controller fails to receive the variable speed run verification input the variable speed compressor is cycled OFF (a variable speed Compressor Emergency Stop Control Event is logged) for 5 seconds and then back on. The variable speed compressor is then ramped to 45%. If this occurs 5 times in a 100 min period the variable speed compressor is shut off and the VCmp1 or VCmp2: Problem alarm is generated.
checks: This alarm must be manually cleared once corrective action is taken.
faultCodes.notes: One description in the manual covers alarms 110, 111 (VCmp1: Problem, VCmp2: Problem).

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 120 "Hi DL Temp_1: Problem" - Normal compressor control is limited when a high discharge line temperature conditions occur. If the variable speed compressor is operating and the discharge line temperature is greater than 250°F for 15 seconds a High Discharge Line Temperature Event is generated and the variable speed compressor capacity is reduced every 15 seconds until the discharge line temperature falls below 220°F. If the discharge line temperature is above 250°F continuously for 3 minutes the variable speed compressor is stopped and a High Discharge Line Temperature problem alarm is generated.
checks: The alarm must be manually cleared.

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 165 "Hi Press 1: Problem" - Normal variable speed compressor control is limited when a high discharge pressure conditions occur on the variable speed compressor circuit. If the discharge pressure is above 575 PSI for 10 minutes the variable speed compressor is shut off and a High Pressure Problem alarm is generated. If the OAT is below 45F at the time the variable speed compressor is shut off immediately and a High Pressure Problem alarm is generated anytime the discharge pressure rises above 575 PSI.
checks: The alarm must be manually cleared.
faultCodes.notes: One description in the manual covers alarms 165, 166 (Hi Press 1: Problem, Hi Press 2: Problem).
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1373-2 (Apr 2026) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel Applied DPSA/DHSA/DAHA (R-32), Service Menus Table 107

faultCodes.meaning: Problem alarm 198 "Freeze: Problem" - When a unit is equipped with chilled water, hot water, or steam coil, the Freeze problem occurs when the optional freezestat contacts open as a result of detecting an abnormally low water or steam coil temperature while the fans are off. When the Freeze problem occurs, the controller opens the chilled water and heating valves, and sets a 10-minute timer. When the 10-minute timer expires, the controller checks the freezestat input again. If the freezestat contacts are closed the valves close. This continues while the unit remains off. This feature protects the coil(s) and allows the system to start normally when an occupied command is received.

Whenever the freezestat closes the Freeze problem automatically clears.

faultCodes.meaning: Fault alarm 252 "Freeze: Fault" - When a unit is equipped with a waterside economizer, chilled water, hot water, or steam coil, the Freeze Fault occurs when the optional freezestat contacts open as a result of detecting an abnormally low water or steam coil temperature while the fans are running. When the Freeze fault occurs, the controller shuts down the fans, opens the chilled water, economizer, and heating valves and set a 10-minute timer. If the unit is equipped with a waterside economizer, the pump output is also turned on. When the 10-minute timer expires, the controller checks the freezestat input again. If the freezestat contacts are closed the pump output is de-energized and the valves close.
checks: If the freezestat contacts are still open the pump output remains energized, the valves remain open, and the 10-minute timer resets.
This continues until the fault is manually cleared through the keypad or via a network signal.
faultCodes.source: Daikin Applied OM 1373-2 (Apr 2026) MicroTech Unit Controller for Rebel Applied DPSA/DHSA/DAHA (R-32), Service Menus Table 108
